newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres 1996 net at 1.823 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Benpres 1996 net at 1.823 bln pesos.

text.p: Benpres Holdings said on Monday its net income in 1996 reached 1.823 billion pesos.
The company did not give a comparative year-ago figure but it has previously reported a 1995 net income of 1.616 billion.
Benpres has holdings in broadcasting, power generation and distribution, banking and telecommunications.
The company said its revenues from equity in net earnings of subsidiaries was 1.882 billion pesos. Other income was at 145.823 million pesos while expenses in the year were 205.333 million pesos.
It said the equity in net earnings figure did not reflect earnings for the month of December, 1996 from subsidiaries Manila Electric Co and PCI Bank.
